(Required) The identity of the user on Infobip WebRTC platform.
Start date and time for filtering of the user activity. Has the following format: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS+ZZZZ`.
End date and time for filtering of the user activity. Has the following format: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS+ZZZZ`.

An identifier that links different occurrences of `activityType` within the same activity session for a user identity on the Infobip WebRTC platform. When two activity events, distinguished by their `activityType`, happen during the same user activity session, they will share the same `sessionId`.
Results page to retrieve (0..N).
Number of records per page.
